Economic Geography –studies the distribution of resources and economic activities within a certain region. May use this information to advise organization where to build new facilities.
Physical Geography- studies earth processes such as climate and weather. Also evaluates the impact of natural hazards such as hurricanes, tornadoes, and earthquakes.
Social and Urban Geography –ensures that community develop in an orderly way and that they have the services necessary to support them.
